description: The illness of the spring - hay fever - suddenly attacked one day. That one got it, this one got it, and Buurin ended up having it too! Ah-choo! Ah-choo!! And she even fails her role as the superheroine. Hey Ton-chan, what`s that ugly mask for...

titles.title: Hakujitsu ni Tadayou Kafun no Wana
白日に漂う花粉のワナ
